payload.blocks: Landing phase 8 of plan 2108 (dead Node execution source deletion), and after it phases 11 and 10.
payload.headline: Widen plan 2108's footprint by one test file so the dead adapters.mjs can be deleted

parts.cause: The reviewer ran the test on the branch and got ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND. The test uses adapters.mjs only for workerBaseEnv, which no live Node code has any more (git grep workerBaseEnv -- src is empty); its Rust owner is packages/execution/engine/src/transport/worker_home.rs. Phase 1's import graph missed it because the path is built with new URL, not imported statically.

options.cost: About 20 test lines removed; one plan.md footprint line; under an hour.
options.does: The supervisor or a planner adds test/holder-lock/driver-unavailable.test.mjs to the plan footprint; a phase 8 fix unit drops its workerEnv case and ADAPTERS_URL and names the Rust owner in the phase report.
options.gain: adapters.mjs is deleted as the plan intends; one change, no leftover dead file.
options.harm: One more footprint commit on main.
options.label: Widen the footprint by this one file

options.cost: One more fix unit now plus a later item.
options.does: Phase 8 restores adapters.mjs and lands without it; a separate backlog item later fixes the test and deletes the file.
options.gain: No footprint change; phase 8 lands sooner.
options.harm: A dead source file stays only for a test, against acceptance criterion 1 and L10; one more item and a second deletion pass.
options.label: Keep adapters.mjs alive for now

parts.recommendation: Widen by the one file: it is the same kind of string-path leftover the owner already approved widening for in q-ms5ifcqex6, and it closes the deletion in one pass.

scope.allows: Adding exactly test/holder-lock/driver-unavailable.test.mjs to the plan footprint and editing only its adapters.mjs/workerBaseEnv case.
scope.forbids: Any other footprint change, any change to src/holder-lock or Rust code, any other test in test/holder-lock.

parts.what: Phase 8 deletes 65 dead Node execution files. Review found that test/holder-lock/driver-unavailable.test.mjs still imports one of them, src/runner/dispatch/adapters.mjs, by a built file URL, so npm test turns red once it is gone. That test file is outside the plan's footprint, and a lead cannot change the footprint.
